core_obligations: Finiteness, surjectivity and birationality of nu: finiteness from the Nagata normalization lemma; nu is an isomorphism over the dense regular open U (regular schemes are normal; the regular locus is dense by ubiquity of J-2), and since dim X <= 1 the non-isomorphism locus is a discrete set of closed points (proof lines 8844-8871).

Derive the short exact sequence 0 -> O_X -> nu_* O_{X^n} ->  direct sum  Q_x -> 0 and, from the stalk description in the normalization lemma, that Q_x = A'/A has finite length equal to the delta invariant at x; Q_x != 0 exactly at singular points by the delta-invariant-is-zero lemma (proof lines 8844-8871).
A' = (nu_* O_{X^n})_x is the integral closure of A in its total ring of fractions and a semi-local finite product of Dedekind domains, both from the normalization lemma (proof lines 8844-8871).

The completion statements (A-hat reduced Noetherian complete local of dimension 1; (A')-hat the integral closure of A-hat and a finite product of complete DVRs; A'/A = (A')-hat/A-hat) are taken from the normalization-after-completion lemma and its proof (proof lines 8844-8871).
proof_roadmap: Assemble finiteness and the sequence with skyscraper quotients from the normalization lemma and the regular-locus density.
Read off the length and singular-point dichotomy from the stalk description.
Transfer the completion statements from the delivered companion lemma.
difficulty_reason: The nine assertions are assembled from the delivered normalization lemma for Noetherian dimension-1 schemes plus finiteness of normalization for Nagata schemes, the ubiquity of regular loci (J-2) for the short exact sequence with skyscraper quotients, the identification of the length of Q_x with the delta invariant, and the completion relationship taken from the normalization-after-completion lemma. H2: assembly of delivered and named inputs into a multi-part structural statement, with the SES and the singular-point dichotomy as the glue.
